title: A section of an ordered affine tower is a vector zero section
statement: Let B be Noetherian, g:T→B have a section s, and r:T≅affineTraceTower(B,d) preserve projection [def-amb-affine-trace-tower]. There are a rank-d finite locally free module F [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], a global frame c:E(F)≅A^d_B over B sending the bundle zero section to the affine zero section, and an isomorphism e:E(F)≅T over B sending its zero section to s.

source.place: Agreement on the model: difference coordinates and the standard-pair DNC

proof.text: Take the free module. Its global frame over the top open gives an isomorphism of its vector scheme with affine d-space, preserving projection and zero.

Identify the tower with affine space and read the section coordinates a. Translation by -a sends the section to zero and has inverse translation by a. Compose the inverse translated coordinates with the free frame; the coordinate universal property proves both equalities.

lean.statement:
theorem affineTowerSection_vectorCoordinates (B : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian B] (d : ℕ)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ B) (s : B ⟶ T) (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 B)
    (r : T ≅ affineTraceTower B d) (hr : r.hom ≫ affineTraceProjection B d = g) :
    ∃ (F : B.Modules) (hF : F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d),
      letI := hF
      ∃ (c : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) B)
        (_wc : c.hom ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) B ↘ B) =
          VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F)
        (_zc : VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ c.hom =
          AffineSpace.zeroSection (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) B)
        (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ T),
        e.hom ≫ g = VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F ∧
        VectorBundleZeroSection.zero B d F ≫ e.hom = s
